interpretation: service latency begins at HTTP service arrival, not native task generation
common model gateway latency for SemLoom Sema begins after its admission; earlier service waiting is excluded
Sema native and transparent upstream peak128 versus SemLoom peak4; no matched request-capacity attribution
Sema postposed Core and actors are recreated per query; query preparation is paid
RSS tree sum double counts shared pages; PSS and CPU are process samples over startup and all queries, not query-isolated
all quantiles are finite nearest-rank observations; query maxima have only5 samples, request P99.99 has only640 at128rows
